newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade at $106-$107 - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade at $106-$107 - private.

text.p: Moderate trade was reported in Nebraska feedlot cattle on Tuesday at prices of $106 to $107 per cwt on a dressed basis, market sources said.
There had been light trade Monday at $105 to $106.
Sources estimated that between 10,000 and 12,000 head had traded so far on Tuesday.
However, some owners continued to price cattle up to $108.
Bids on a live basis were at $66 per cwt with offers mostly at $67.
